verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms OpenHands agents can run in isolated backends—locally, in Docker, on VMs, or via hosted cloud execution—implying sandboxed code execution, and the Software Agent SDK is built for agents that 'work with code.' However, there is no explicit documentation of dependency installation workflows, sandbox security guarantees, or file/network isolation details. Missing for 10: explicit dependency-installation-in-sandbox docs, security/isolation guarantees, hands-on verification of safe execution.
